worldcombat.skill.psychocut.summary: A blade of solidified psychic power is formed in front of the user and thrown; it steers itself toward the target and, on its first real contact, wounds only the one body it reaches and cuts a short gash along its actual incoming direction. It can be thrown at a direction or a point, and a wall stops the blade. A homing single-target ranged slash with the family's raised critical chance.
The blade deals about %1$s slicing damage and lands critical hits more often.
The blade flies at %1$s blocks per tick over %2$s blocks, steering up to %3$s degrees per tick toward the target.
The hit cuts a short gash about %1$s blocks long (half-length) along the actual incoming direction; only the one foe the blade reaches is settled, with no side damage.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.keen.on: Keen form: a heavier blade and a longer cut, at slower flight and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.keen.off: Swift form: faster flight and a shorter cooldown, at lower power and a shorter cut.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.growth.0: From level %1$s the blade rises to %2$s and the cut to about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.growth.1: From level %1$s the blade rises to %2$s, the range to %3$s blocks and the cut to about %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.use.0: Throw a blade of solidified psychic power
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.use.1: The blade steers itself toward a moving target
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.use.2: A hit wounds only the one foe the blade reaches
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.preference.k: On: 112% power and a 0.35 blocks longer cut, at 85% flight speed and +8 cooldown. Off: 115% flight speed and -6 cooldown, at 94% power and a 0.2 blocks shorter cut.
worldcombat.skill.psychocut.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of throwing. Larger values throw from further away.
On: below 45% health a target is thrown at first to finish it. Off: it ranks the blade as an ordinary ranged slash whatever the health.
world_combat.move.psychocut.text.wall: The blade shattered on the wall
